title: Finals week with ten PDFs: which AI reviewer to use
summary: Sort the PDFs by exam objective before sending anything to a reviewer.
body_markdown:
Use a source notebook for the PDFs you still need to understand and a short question list for the material you need to remember. Before uploading anything, match the ten files to the finals coverage your instructor gave you. The first file worth studying may be the shortest one, particularly if it explains a method that appears throughout the other readings.


## Asking “paano mag-review para sa exam nang mabilis” during finals week?


Start with the exam task and work backwards to the files that teach it. On paper, list what you must be able to do by exam day. Use verbs you can demonstrate, such as interpreting a chart, comparing two arguments or explaining the steps in a method. Beside each task, write the title of the PDF that contains the clearest worked explanation. Leave the space blank if you do not know yet.


Next, glance at each file's headings, introduction and closing exercise. Identify the main reading, supporting examples and repeated copies. A revised handout and its earlier version should not count as separate topics. Keep the version your instructor assigned and mark the other one as superseded. If you are unsure which is current, ask the class representative or instructor before studying two answers to the same question.

School guidance The education-sector advisory leaves schools responsible for choosing suitable protections for personal data they hold.[Source](https://privacy.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/DP-Council-Education-Sector-Advisory-No.-2020-1.pdf) (checked 2026-11-27)


## I have finals next week and ten PDFs to read. Which AI app can help me review?


NotebookLM is a reasonable choice for navigating several permitted sources. Google documents up to 50 sources per notebook for a personal Gmail account, so the number of PDFs alone is unlikely to determine your choice. A single poorly scanned page can take more checking than a long searchable document. Look at the pages you actually need before assuming they will all be equally useful in the notebook.[Notebooklm documentation, checked 2026-11-27](https://support.google.com/gemininotebook/answer/16213268?hl=en) .


If the source is already clear and you need practice from an allowed lecture file, Educato is another route. Choose one format for the first session and stick with it long enough to answer a question without looking. Trying several accounts in the same evening can consume the time you set aside for the difficult chapter. You can always use plain paper for tomorrow's retries.


## How would you prioritize an actual pile of readings?


Imagine a fictional Philippine college communications final. Your instructor asks you to compare how two public notices address different audiences. Your files include a lecture on audience, scans of sample notices, a glossary, a group report and readings from earlier units. Opening the glossary first feels productive because you can recognize the terms. But the task is comparing the notices, so the samples and the lecture go to the top of the pile.


Cover the analysis printed below the first sample. Write a tentative answer naming the audience and quoting the phrase that tells you. Then open the second notice and look for the same kind of evidence. Suppose both notices announce a change of venue, but one tells enrolled participants to bring a confirmation while the other invites neighbours to observe. The change of venue is common ground. The invitation and the confirmation instruction support the contrast.


Now give the reviewer a precise job. Ask which section of the audience lecture explains how a writer signals who should act. Read that section and revise your comparison. If the generated outline focuses on where the event moved, reject that as the organizing idea. It may describe both notices correctly while doing little to answer the question the instructor actually set.


## What should you do when an important PDF is difficult to read?


Identify the troublesome page and decide whether you need the image, its caption or the surrounding argument. In the notices exercise, the audience cue might appear in a small line below the heading. Zoom in and inspect it yourself. Type a short, checked transcription into your own notes if the line is legible. If the scan cuts it off, borrow an authorized clean copy or ask the instructor. Generating a plausible ending wastes time twice.


Do the same for assigned readings you cannot upload. Put the title, page and your own explanation in a notebook, then return to the book or file to verify them. A lecturer's permission to read a class file may not extend to sharing it with a service. Keep grades and identifiable educational information out of practice materials. The Philippine education-sector advisory explains why those details need care.[Philippine education-sector advisory, checked 2026-11-27](https://www.privacy.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/DP-Council-Education-Sector-Advisory-No.-2020-1.pdf) .


## How do you divide the remaining days?


Use the earliest available session for the topic that blocks later work. If understanding the audience lecture unlocks several document comparisons, study it before a narrow list of terms you can rehearse on the last evening. At the end of that session, leave yourself a closed-book prompt. The next day, answer it before rereading anything. This shows whether the explanation survived an ordinary gap between classes.


Use a later session to mix the tasks. Follow a comparison question with an explanation from another unit, then go back to a fresh notice. Keep each answer short enough to check against its source. When an answer is wrong, note which cue you missed and where you found it. A missed cue is a better plan for the next session than a general instruction to reread the whole folder.


## What can you leave out on the last evening?


Leave out duplicate examples once you have answered an unfamiliar version correctly and explained why. Keep the materials linked to unresolved objectives within reach. If you only have time for a final pass through one sheet, put your difficult questions on the front and page references on the back. Run through the questions in a different order from the lecture so the sequence cannot supply the answer.


When a file remains untouched, look at its role on the course outline before deciding what to do. An optional background reading and the only assigned example of a required method deserve different treatment. If the missing file covers a required task, do one representative exercise and check it properly. Finishing finals review means being able to perform the assessed work, even if some optional pages are still unread.
